\chapter{Mem0 Memory Provider for Hermes Agent}
\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin:mem0-memory-provider-for-hermes-agent}}\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This plugin integrates mem0.ai with Hermes Agent as an additional memory provider.


\section{Configuration}
\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin:configuration}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add to your Hermes config:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nt}{memory}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{providers}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{p+pIndicator}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nt}{type}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{mem0}
\PYG{+w}{      }\PYG{n+nt}{user\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{hermes\PYGZus{}user}\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optional: defaults to \PYGZsq{}hermes\PYGZus{}user\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{+w}{      }\PYG{n+nt}{api\PYGZus{}key}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{\PYGZdl{}\PYGZob{}MEM0\PYGZus{}API\PYGZus{}KEY\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or hardcode (not recommended)}
\PYG{+w}{      }\PYG{n+nt}{base\PYGZus{}url}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{https://api.mem0.ai}\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optional}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\section{Environment Variables}
\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin:environment-variables}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{MEM0\_API\_KEY}}: Your mem0 API key

\end{itemize}


\section{Installation}
\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin:installation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Install the mem0 Python package:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
pip\PYG{+w}{ }install\PYG{+w}{ }mem0ai
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\section{How it works}
\label{\detokenize{mem0-memory-plugin:how-it-works}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Mem0 serves as a \sphinxstylestrong{complementary} memory provider alongside Honcho:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Honcho}: Stores structured peer observations about the user, durable facts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Mem0}: Provides semantic search over conversation history, recent context

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Both can run simultaneously \sphinxhyphen{} Hermes queries all configured memory providers.
